PluginData.Author: Polar
PluginData.Tooltip: Nudge grids one block at a time or carry them like copy and paste, without copying, and merge them into the grid they touch
PluginData.Description:
Move a grid without copying it: nudge it one block at a time, or carry it in the vanilla paste preview. Same grid and block ids.
Ctrl+Numpad8 / 2: forward / back Ctrl+Numpad4 / 6: left / right Ctrl+Numpad9 / 3: up / down Ctrl+Numpad5: lock onto the aimed grid, or unlock Ctrl+Numpad1: carry the grid, or put it back Ctrl+Numpad7: auto-merge on / off
Carrying works exactly like Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V: rotate with the block rotation keys, Ctrl+wheel for distance, left click places, Esc puts it back. The original is hidden until placed, then moved there. Clears the clipboard.
Nudge directions follow the camera and stay fixed for 3 seconds. Subgrids come along. Nudges into another grid are refused.
Auto-merge: a moved grid lines up with a square grid of the same size and merges where block faces connect.
Needs NumLock, single player, creative mode or creative tools. No settings.
Known issues: terrain is not checked when nudging. No undo.
Source: https://github.com/Po11arr/PolarsGridMover
